HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 70-year-old male admitted for cellulitis of the left lower leg. Admission data:

Assessment and plan: Cellulitis of the left lower leg. Type 2 diabetes. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 70-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Cellulitis of the left lower leg. Type 2 diabetes. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
